title: athyrium bulbiferum
intro: Athyrium bulbiferum, commonly known as the Autumn fern or Autumn lady fern, is a species of flowering plant in the fern family, native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating pain, making it beneficial for treating conditions such as arthritis and gout. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium bulbiferum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
